POLICY_TEXT: Invoices within 5 percent of an approved PO may be automatically reconciled when supporting contractual evidence exists.
Potential duplicate invoices must never be automatically paid or resolved without verification.
Delays exceeding 10 days or affecting a committed customer order require human escalation.
Approved contract amendments supersede stale ERP values when amendment effective date precedes invoice or shipment commitment.
Conflicting or incomplete evidence must not be resolved automatically. Additional evidence or human review is required.
